# AbdullahBuilt — full site context

AbdullahBuilt (abdullahbuilt.top, also written "Abdullah Built") is the independent practice of Muhammad Abdullah. Muhammad Abdullah is an independent product builder and full-stack engineer based in Faisalabad, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide. He turns early product ideas, business problems, manual workflows, and difficult features into working software.

## Capabilities
Product definition, user flows, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, React, responsive interfaces, Supabase, Postgres, Prisma, REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, AI and LLM integrations, controlled agent workflows, workflow automation, GitHub tooling, blockchain-connected products, smart-contract integration, Arc, USDC, Circle CCTP, LI.FI, testing, deployment, and iteration.

## Engagements
A suitable engagement can be a complete first release or a defined feature in an existing product. Start with the user, important task, current state, constraints, required systems, and smallest complete workflow. Delivery can include implementation, testing, deployment, and handoff.

## Services and decision support
The site includes dedicated pages for custom software, SaaS, web applications, API integrations, business automation, MVPs, AI application or agent workflows, and product rescue. Buyer guides cover developer selection, MVP scope, build-versus-buy decisions, SaaS MVP cost drivers, API integration planning, AI product architecture, webhook reliability, and rescuing unstable or AI-built applications.

## Selected work
All four builds are public, testnet-stage products. No users, volume, revenue, returns, or audits are claimed.

- RESOLVE — evidence-backed contribution funding: evidence connectors, identity resolution, versioned policy snapshots, quadratic funding in bigint micro-USDC, and ERC-8183 escrow via Circle. Settlement runs on Arc Testnet, and live on-chain payouts are currently disabled by a feature flag. Role: full-stack engineer. https://www.useresolve.stream (case study: https://abdullahbuilt.top/work/resolve/)
- MERIDIAN — explainable market-strategy desk from the BNB Hackathon (Track 2): eight deterministic skills, a nine-check gate, a GRANT/DENY constitution permit, replay against a baseline, and wallet-signed swaps on BSC Testnet. Co-built — Muhammad Abdullah served as full-stack engineer, with work including the Gate strategy desk and BSC testnet execution. https://meridianarc.stream (case study: https://abdullahbuilt.top/work/meridian/)
- RepoDiet — contract-bound repository maintenance from the OKX.AI Genesis Hackathon: evidence-gated triage, signed commit-pinned contracts, isolated branches, and a separate verifier role with its own verification and signing boundary (in the same service) issuing in-toto/DSSE receipts. Public JavaScript/TypeScript repositories only. Role: full-stack engineer. https://repodiet.uk (case study: https://abdullahbuilt.top/work/repodiet/)
- Agora Forge — cross-chain USDC portfolio workspace from the Agora Agent Hackathon: multichain portfolio aggregation, Circle CCTP via Circle App Kit (testnet), LI.FI route comparison and quote-to-transaction execution, and a rule-based, wallet-approved agent console (not an AI/LLM agent). Role: full-stack engineer. https://circle-arc-net.vercel.app/ (case study: https://abdullahbuilt.top/work/agora-forge/)
